about: Licence path map and dependency audit for hackbuild-fab (docs/plan/LICENSING.md sections 1.2 and 2). paths is read top to bottom, first match wins. dependencies holds one row per package in package-lock.json and tools/py/uv.lock; tools/licences.mjs --check fails on a missing row.

paths.note: owner's mark, outside every open grant; later logo files join this row. The vtracer corpus rasters 01, 02 and 05 show the wrench mark and the hack.build wordmark (05 is the coin preview the python hack.build coin script rendered, read 2026-10-13)

IBM Plex Mono woff2 from @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono 5.3.0; the package LICENSE, IBM copyright line and OFL text, sits beside them as reference/copper/_inputs/OFL-1.1.txt (M05-T13). This row sits above the reference/*/*/** chase row, which would otherwise match first

IBM Plex Mono 400 and 700 woff2 from @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono 5.3.0, byte equal to reference/copper/_inputs (sha256 measured 2026-10-14), and the glyph table packages/geom/scripts/fonts.mjs writes from them, a format conversion of the Font Software; the package LICENSE sits beside the woff2 as packages/geom/assets/fonts/OFL-1.1.txt. The node text route sets inlay text from the table (OK-01)

IBM Plex Mono 400, 600, 700 woff2 from @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono 5.3.0, byte equal to SHUNT R1 fonts/ (sha256 measured 2026-10-09); the package LICENSE sits beside them as tools/py/board/fonts/OFL-1.1.txt. The direct-emit textpoly reads them (M08-T06)

Permanent Marker and Special Elite woff2 from @fontsource/permanent-marker 5.3.0 and @fontsource/special-elite 5.3.0, byte equal to the package files (sha256 measured 2026-10-09); each package LICENSE (Apache-2.0 with the font copyright line) sits beside them as LICENSE-permanent-marker.txt and LICENSE-special-elite.txt (M08-T06)
template text copied verbatim into user outputs; the filling code stays MIT

harvested originals of the owner's designs and boards; they take the folder's ChaseMeta.license, CC-BY-SA-4.0 for printable designs and CERN-OHL-W-2.0 for boards (owner, 2026-10-13); texts LICENSES/CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt and LICENSES/CERN-OHL-W-2.0.txt

the folder's ChaseMeta.license where a chase.ts declares one; a folder without a chase.ts carries no grant. Printable designs are CC-BY-SA-4.0 and boards CERN-OHL-W-2.0 (owner, 2026-10-13); texts LICENSES/CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt and LICENSES/CERN-OHL-W-2.0.txt
failure corpus and knowledge records, community coupons credited by contributor (owner, 2026-10-13)
code samples inside are also MIT (owner, 2026-10-13)

KiCad libraries, collection redistribution; KiCad's LICENSE.md sits beside them. The pj398sm footprint is a byte copy from github.com/KiCad/kicad-footprints at 7ebfa6b2 (2020-10-02), with that repository's LICENSE.md beside it
